body:
Resolve Wave 1 audit findings for Windows cross-platform compatibility:
1. In lib/digest.mjs:
   - In collect(), determine file executable classification cls ('x' vs 'f') as:
     const isExec = process.platform === 'win32'
       ? (relpath.endsWith('.sh') || relpath.startsWith('bin/') || relpath.endsWith('bin/adlc.mjs'))
       : Boolean(fs.statSync(full).mode & EXEC_BITS);
     const cls = isExec ? 'x' : 'f';
   - Verify that computeDirectoryDigest('vendor/adlc') matches KNOWN_VENDORED_ADLC.treeDigest from lib/adlc-bridge.mjs on both Windows and POSIX.
2. In hooks/policy/paths.mjs:
   - In isWithin(candidate, parent): normalize candidate and parent using .replace(/\\/g, '/') before performing the normalized prefix check, ensuring mixed slashes on win32 match.
3. In lib/doctor.mjs:
   - In checkSecondaryInstall(): import { delimiter } from 'node:path' and split PATH using path.delimiter instead of hardcoded ':'.
   - In checkPolicyGuard(): replace the hardcoded spawnSync('/bin/sh', ['-c', command], ...) with:
     const shellBin = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'cmd.exe' : '/bin/sh';
     const shellArgs = process.platform === 'win32' ? ['/d', '/s', '/c', command] : ['-c', command];
     return spawnSync(shellBin, shellArgs, { cwd, env, timeout, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
4. In lib/migrate.mjs:
   - In handOverUninstall(): when process.platform === 'win32', invoke spawn('cmd.exe', ['/c', uninstallerPath], { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' }).unref(); otherwise spawn('/bin/sh', [uninstallerPath], ...).
5. In lib/bootstrap.mjs:
   - In the version probe of resolvedAgyBin around line 282, pass shell: process.platform === 'win32' in execFileSync options so that Windows batch wrappers (agy.cmd / agy.ps1) execute without ENOENT.

Verification: npm test && node bin/agb.mjs doctor
title: Wave 1: Windows Platform Compatibility and Path Normalization
